authorization: User agreed to a one-off read-only Jev review; no scheduled restart or trading authority.
privacy: Only request is transmitted. No wallets, token names/addresses, trade IDs, balances, individual transactions, secrets, or local paths in request.

state.task: One-off read-only strategy-design audit, not trade authorization, price prediction, or a profitability claim. All figures below were calculated locally; do not recompute numeric quantities. Local facts are a bounded historical paper snapshot, not live trading data.

historicalPaperSnapshot.peakEvidence: Accepted quote maxima only. No peak timestamps, continuous historical confirmation sequence or executable sell depth. These counts are not confirmed threshold fills.
historicalPaperSnapshot.profitabilityStatus: No demonstrated stable edge; no independent samples for principal recovery.

proposedStudy.comparison: One chosen treatment multiplier versus actual main exit on the same new entries; NOT three multipliers concurrently. Changing multiplier within a checkpoint freezes the study.
proposedStudy.entry: Only actual new main paper buys after activation, same all-in capital and quantity, existing safety/liquidity/freshness/position limits unchanged.
proposedStudy.trigger: Price reaches chosen entry-price multiple; next distinct later fresh quote must still reach it. Retrace disarms. Main exit on same commit takes precedence.
proposedStudy.partialSale: Sell the minimum modeled quantity to net-recover original all-in entry outlay after exit fees, slippage, taxes and full gas. Infeasible recovery or no remainder means no partial fill.
proposedStudy.accounting: Recovery cash is not all realized profit. Allocate original basis proportionately; remaining basis is not zero. Count every sale cost and future gas; no reuse of recovered capital.
proposedStudy.tail: Remaining quantity exits at the SAME actual main exit time and price. Does not extend holdings after main exit. Original risk exit remains active even below the multiplier.
proposedStudy.validation: 177 offline tests pass; no real forward experiment or profitability validation.

constraints: No model output may modify strategy, ledger, processes, account, or execute trades.
Unknown or insufficient evidence is allowed. Do not infer executable trades from historical maxima.
No widening entry gates, no larger position, no indefinite hold.
Review is structured classification only; any Chinese prose report is written separately by the caller, not generated by Jev.

hypotheses.two: Earlier modeled principal recovery if threshold confirmed; larger fraction sold at the same cost schedule, possibly lower later upside.
hypotheses.three: Later recovery threshold; more tokens retained if achieved, but more runs may exit before recovery.
hypotheses.five: Highest recovery threshold among these; most residual tokens conditional on recovery, potentially lowest activation coverage.
hypotheses.comparisonWarning: Structural tradeoffs, not calibrated probabilities, future returns or proof one multiplier is optimal.

supported_multiplier.instructions: Based only on the historical evidence and the unrun study, which multiplier has sufficient comparative evidence to be called the highest-net-return rule?

criteria.two: 2x is supported as superior by comparable net outcome evidence.
criteria.three: 3x is supported as superior by comparable net outcome evidence.
criteria.five: 5x is supported as superior by comparable net outcome evidence.
criteria.none_supported: The supplied observations do not identify a superior multiplier.
criteria.unknown: Cannot determine whether the evidence supports any comparison.

giveback_coverage.instructions: Will the 2x/3x/5x recovery rules trigger on the six given giveback loss cases within their recorded observations?

criteria.all: All six would trigger under at least one proposed threshold.
criteria.some: Some but not all would trigger under at least one proposed threshold.
criteria.none_in_recorded_observations: None has a recorded price reaching the lowest proposed threshold; unobserved paths remain unknown.
criteria.unknown: The supplied recorded observations are insufficient to classify this question.

comparison_design.instructions: Which candidate evaluation design would best isolate the effect of choosing 2x, 3x or 5x from changes in market regime, using only future observations?

criteria.paired_preregistered: Freeze all candidate rules and compare them on the same future eligible entries and quotes, count nontriggers, costs, exclusions and complete outcomes.
criteria.sequential_periods: Choose one multiplier per separate calendar period and rank their raw net PnL without matching entries.
criteria.historical_peak_replay: Use saved maximum prices to simulate historical threshold exits as if filled.
criteria.unknown: No adequate comparison design can be selected.

cash_risk.instructions: Does net cash recovery equal original all-in spend guarantee the remaining trade is risk-free with zero remaining cost basis?

criteria.both_guaranteed: Yes: both risk-free tail and zero remaining basis follow.
criteria.cash_only: It establishes modeled recovered cash, not zero accounting basis or freedom from future gas, illiquidity and contract risks.
criteria.profit_only: The entire recovered amount should be classified as realized profit.
criteria.unknown: Cannot classify the cash and risk interpretation.

tail_scope.instructions: What hypothesis does the proposed remainder policy actually test?

criteria.same_exit_partial_recovery: Partial principal recovery before the unchanged final main exit; no independent extension beyond main exit.
criteria.independent_long_tail: An independent long-tail exit that holds after the main exit and captures later rallies.
criteria.unlimited_hold: Indefinitely hold remainder until a future multiplier regardless of risk exit.
criteria.unknown: The terminal exit policy is unspecified.

two_vs_five_tradeoff.instructions: Which qualitative tradeoff is supported by the specified 2x and 5x designs, without claiming which is more profitable?

criteria.earlier_recovery_vs_more_residual: 2x offers an earlier recovery threshold; 5x retains more tokens conditional on recovery but can miss recovery before the existing risk exit.
criteria.five_always_better: 5x necessarily produces higher total net profit because fewer tokens are sold.
criteria.two_always_better: 2x necessarily produces higher total net profit because principal is recovered sooner.
criteria.unknown: The mechanism does not determine this structural tradeoff.
